message: Astra: Across your last two drafts, the divided tree still leads directly to lessons about change; what, if anything, has changed in what a reader can actually picture? Within this notebook scene, is another full expansion likely to give you new evidence, or has that approach become repetitive? What about this tree deserves sustained thought before you revise, and why would that thinking be worth more than an informative attempt now? What textual difference would help you judge whether your chosen approach worked? Could you choose and carry out that next step?
